name: Acceptance test 13 - Allow with NotAction (complement grant, excluded set never shown as allowed)
note: IAM-704 complement handling. An Allow written with NotAction iam:* grants every action EXCEPT iam:* - a broad inverse (near-administrative) grant. The engine MODELS it (rather than blocking, so the NotAction rule family and its fixtures stay intact) but must NEVER present the EXCLUDED set (iam:*) as an allowed action: the granted-action summary is '*' and the excluded list rides in a separate excludedActions field. Complement grants are approximate, so policy-evidence is reduced a notch (high -> medium) and the limit carries a complement caveat. Analysis is NOT blocked (the shape is a valid identity policy); coverage is a normal identity result.
